name: Star Stable
storyline:
For centuries, mystery has surrounded the island of Jorvik.
Legend says Jorvik was once nothing more than a desolate rock in the cold dark sea until one magical and stormy night a star struck down.
A girl on horseback sprang forth from the fading flames she rode gracefully across the surface of the stormy water leaving calm and stillness in her wake carrying with her a light and a golden harp. The girl and her horse reached the bleak and lifeless shores and she cast down her light in the very centre of the island. Waves of life began to surge across the island and all that was once cold and dark was brought to life through warmth and light.

Legend has it that the horses of Jorvik share a special bond with the islanders.

Deep beneath the sea, an ancient force of evil known as Garnok has been resting since the beginning of time. In secret, the mystical Keepers of Aideen fight to keep the darkness away and protect Jorvik from those who want to destroy its light.

In times of despair a sisterhood of Soul Riders will ride forth to protect the island from the evil that seeks to rip the world apart. It is foretold that a sisterhood led by a heroic and fearless girl will appear on horseback to bring hope and light back to those who believe that all is lost.
Are you that girl?
summary: Star Stable Online is a MMORPG built for those with a passion for horses and games. It is a modern continuation and expansion of the story told in the single-player CD-ROM PC Starshine Legacy series and the Star Stable Season Riders series. Players are immersed in the magical world of Jorvik, an island known for it's passion for horses, they say that riders on Jorvik can bond with their horse deeper than anywhere else in the world. They can ride and explore, customize their character, buy horses, compete in different races and competitions, chat and hang out with other players, and uncover the game's rich story and lore in the main quests.
